annotations.title: EU De Minimis State Aid Screener (Reg. 2023/2831)

description:
[EU De Minimis State Aid auditor. Pure calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Audits state aid applications against the new €300,000 3-year rolling ceiling under Commission Regulation (EU) 2023/2831, consolidating linked enterprises under the single undertaking ('Impresa Unica') rule and sector restrictions.
Usage: Use this tool to verify available de minimis subsidy headroom before submitting public grant applications.
Returns: JSON object with { companyName: string, isEligibleForRequestedAid: boolean, statutoryCeilingEur: number, totalPriorAidAccumulatedEur: number, remainingHeadroomAvailableEur: number, singleUndertakingAudit: object, complianceVerdict: string }.

companyVatOrId.description: Enterprise tax ID or national VAT number

economicSector.description: Economic activity sector for ceiling determination

hasLinkedEnterprisesInSingleUndertaking.description: True if applicant is part of a corporate group under Art. 2(2) single undertaking rule

linkedEnterprisesPriorAidTotalEur.description: Total de minimis aid granted to linked enterprises in the single undertaking

priorAidsGrantedIn3YearRollingWindow.description: List of prior de minimis subsidies conceded across 3-year rolling window

requestedAidAmountEur.description: Gross grant equivalent of requested state aid in EUR

name: de_minimis_state_aid_screener
title: EU De Minimis State Aid Screener (Reg. 2023/2831)
